purpose: Icon + one sans body line, in the final-CTA 3-up reassurance row.
geometry: asymmetric per-column widths 25em / 29em / 25em, with per-column phone/mini overrides
maxWordsBasis: counted from the real PRICING_COLUMNS array
states: No hover, no active, no focus, no transition, no box-shadow.
criticalNote: NOT the same component as column.icon-feature-serif: this one is fixed-em width with a sans body and no serif sub-heading. The per-column mini overrides differ (col 1 mb-[4.6em], col 3 mb-[4.2em]) and are reproduced exactly rather than normalised.
